hints: Let $X$ represent the height of a maize plant, so $X \sim \mathrm{N}(1.62, \sigma^2)$. Express the condition $\mathrm{P}(X > 1.8) = 0.15$ in terms of the standard normal variable $Z \sim \mathrm{N}(0, 1)$.
Use the upper-tail identity $\mathrm{P}(Z > z) = 1 - \Phi(z) = 0.15$, so $\Phi(z) = 0.85$. Look up the critical value $z$ corresponding to $0.85$ in the normal distribution table.
Set up the standardisation equation $z = \dfrac{1.8 - 1.62}{\sigma}$ with your found $z$-value, and solve for $\sigma$.
walkthrough:
Define the normal distribution for maize plant height $X \sim \mathrm{N}(1.62, \sigma^2)$ and relate the upper-tail probability to the standard normal variable $Z$:
$$\mathrm{P}(X > 1.8) = 0.15 \implies \mathrm{P}\left(Z > \dfrac{1.8 - 1.62}{\sigma}\right) = 0.15$$

Use the complement of the cumulative distribution function to find the corresponding $z$-score:
$$\mathrm{P}(Z < z) = 1 - 0.15 = 0.85 \implies z = \Phi^{-1}(0.85) = 1.037$$

Equate the standardised formula to $1.037$ and solve for $\sigma$:
$$\dfrac{1.8 - 1.62}{\sigma} = 1.037 \implies \dfrac{0.18}{\sigma} = 1.037 \implies \sigma = \dfrac{0.18}{1.037} \approx 0.173578\dots \approx 0.174\text{ m}$$
teacher_walkthrough:
We are given that 15% of plants are taller than 1.8 m. Subtract this from 1 to find the probability that a plant is shorter than 1.8 m:
$$\mathrm{P}(X < 1.8) = 1 - 0.15 = 0.85$$

Look up $0.85$ in the main body of the standard normal distribution table to find the corresponding Z-score:
$$\Phi(z) = 0.85 \implies z = 1.037$$

Start with the standardization formula connecting measurement $X$, mean $\mu$, standard deviation $\sigma$, and Z-score:
$$Z = \frac{X - \mu}{\sigma}$$

Substitute our known values: $Z = 1.037$, $X = 1.8\text{ m}$, and $\mu = 1.62\text{ m}$:
$$1.037 = \frac{1.8 - 1.62}{\sigma}$$

Subtract in the numerator to find the difference ($1.8 - 1.62 = 0.18$):
$$1.037 = \frac{0.18}{\sigma}$$

Multiply both sides by $\sigma$ and divide by $1.037$ to isolate the standard deviation:
$$\sigma = \frac{0.18}{1.037} \approx 0.173577 \approx 0.174\text{ m}$$
